dimensions.name: c
dimensions.meaning: SVM penalty parameter (larger means weaker regularization)

dimensions.name: gamma
dimensions.meaning: RBF kernel coefficient (larger means narrower kernel)

beliefs.note: Standard RBF-SVM sweet spot: moderate regularization (C~1) and kernel width matching feature scale (gamma ~ 1/num_features or slightly smaller). For ~2000 records with mixed features, C=1 and gamma=0.0625 (1/16) is a robust starting prior.
Very high C often leads to overfitting on noisy or imbalanced data, especially with limited budget.
Very high gamma creates extremely narrow kernels, leading to overfitting and sensitivity to noise.

trust.notes: Based on general SVM hyperparameter tuning heuristics for imbalanced classification tasks. The specific feature distribution is unknown, so the prior is centered on standard defaults but allows for exploration.
